mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stage (season_id, name, type, sort_order, status) VALUES (#{seasonId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{sortOrder}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE stage SET name = #{name}, type = #{type}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stage WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT * FROM stage WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} AND type = 'LEAGUE' ORDER BY sort_order, id LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM stage WHERE season_id = #{seasonId} AND type = #{type} ORDER BY sort_order, id LIMIT 1
